name: Uozu (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Uozu city emblem in white: a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Uozu, a city in Toyama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 April 1957.

features.role: Uozu city emblem — a ring with two pointed ears enclosing a stylised character
